verdict.rationale: Memory capacity and bandwidth are fair questions for a laptop processor, so this axis applies. The evidence pack gives no addressable-memory figure, no published bandwidth, and no evidence of running a 70B-class model. It offers only generic marketing about LLM inference optimizations (oneDNN/PyTorch, OpenVINO) and NPU TOPS, which are software building blocks and adjacent specs, not the capability this story asks about.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a large local LLM (70B-class, quantized) on this platform — enough addressable memory and published memory bandwidth to make local inference practical
